summary: This file is a training schedule configuration for an MMDetection-style framework. It defines optimizer settings (SGD with lr=0.02, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0001), gradient clipping config (disabled), learning rate policy (step-based with linear warmup over 500 iterations, stepping at epochs 16 and 19), and total training epochs (20). It contains no functions, classes, or callable APIs — only configuration variables used by a training framework's config system.
